signal: S&P 500 CAPE 10Y percentile observed at t-1

rules.Fixed_60_40: 60% S&P 500 / 40% RMB cash, monthly weights restored
rules.CAPE_tilt_100_75_50: 100% equity if lagged CAPE percentile <=20; 75% if >20 and <80; 50% if >=80; remaining weight RMB cash; 10bp one-way cost on equity-weight changes

limitations: Single S&P 500 + RMB cash pilot only; not a global 52/28/10/10 portfolio.
CAPE is a slow-moving valuation metric and may remain high for years; results are highly sample-dependent.
Signal is deliberately lagged by one full month; no look-ahead from same-month returns.
No taxes, bid-ask spread, ETF tracking difference, withholding tax or account-specific FX conversion cost.
No optimization on the test sample; thresholds are fixed ex ante at 20/80 percentile and 100/75/50% equity weights.
Must compare against alternative thresholds and rolling out-of-sample periods before any policy use.
